_comment: GAME_PLAN 20: every deflection method with its tag. status: IMPLEMENTED (in the planner/resolver now) or PLANNED (milestone). Tags are content: never change them here.

methods.name: KINETIC IMPACTOR
methods.equation: dv = beta (m/M) U
methods.note: DART calibration: 580 kg at 6.1 km/s, beta 3.6, dv 2.7 mm/s

methods.name: PRECURSOR CRATERING PROBE
methods.equation: reveals strength multiplier and beta range

methods.name: CIVIL DEFENSE / EVACUATION
methods.equation: damage x {0.3 airburst, 0.4 city, 0.7 regional}; hit survivable if evacuated >= 7 d out (AIRBURST/CITY)

methods.name: NUCLEAR STANDOFF (X-RAY ABLATION)
methods.equation: f_omega = (1 - sqrt(1 - (R/(R+H))^2))/2;  dv = C_m eps f_omega Y / M

methods.name: NUCLEAR SURFACE / SUBSURFACE
methods.equation: f_omega 0.5 / 1.0, eps 0.5 / 0.9, then the disruption branch

methods.name: HAIV
methods.equation: leader crater + follower warhead; accuracy 0.7

methods.name: HAMMER (NASA/NNSA 2018)
methods.equation: 8.8 t vehicle, kinetic or nuclear

methods.name: NUCLEAR PULSE TRAIN
methods.equation: sum of standoff impulses, fragmentation check after each

methods.name: GRAVITY TRACTOR
methods.equation: a = G m_sc / d^2, d >= 1.5 R

methods.name: ENHANCED GRAVITY TRACTOR
methods.equation: m_sc += boulder (<= 20 t)

methods.name: ION BEAM SHEPHERD
methods.equation: a = F_beam / M; F 0.1 / 0.5 / 2 N

methods.name: LASER ABLATION (DE-STARLITE)
methods.equation: F = 3e-5 N/W x P; 50 kW / 200 kW / 1 MW

methods.name: GROUND-BASED LASER (PHIPPS)
methods.equation: F = C_m P x 0.3 within 0.05 AU

methods.name: SOLAR CONCENTRATOR / MIRROR BEES
methods.equation: P = 0.6 x 1361 x A; F = 1e-4 P; A decays 10%/month

methods.name: MASS DRIVER
methods.equation: F = m_dot v_e; 0.1 / 1 / 10 kg/s at 500 m/s

methods.name: TUGBOAT
methods.equation: a = eta_spin F / M; eta_spin 0.3 unless despun

methods.name: TETHER BALLAST
methods.equation: dr = L m_b / (M + m_b): ~100 m. Shown so the number is on screen

methods.name: ELECTROSTATIC TRACTOR
methods.equation: screened by solar-wind plasma (Debye ~10 m): F ~ 0. NOT VIABLE

methods.name: MAGNETIC TRACTOR (IRON)
methods.equation: contact induction tug, eta_spin 0.5

methods.name: YARKOVSKY / ALBEDO PAINT
methods.equation: da/dt ~ 2e-4 AU/Myr: ~300 m in 10 years. NOT VIABLE at game timescales

methods.name: SOLAR SAIL ON THE BODY
methods.equation: F = 2 P_rad A (AU/r)^2; 1 km^2 gives ~9 N

methods.name: ELECTRIC / MAGNETIC SAIL TUG
methods.equation: F ~ 0.5 mN per km of tether at 1 AU

methods.name: PI: PULVERIZE IT
methods.equation: penetrator array shreds < 100 m into < 10 m pieces; damage 0.05 E; down to T-12 h

methods.name: CAPTURE BAG (ARM STYLE)
methods.equation: < 10 m body or fragment captured: resolved

methods.name: CONVENTIONAL EXPLOSIVES
methods.equation: Q from 4.2 MJ/kg; weak; a fragmentation hazard

methods.name: DUST CLOUD BRAKING
methods.equation: drag impulse from a donor cloud within 0.05 AU; rare

methods.name: MULTIPLE-MISSION CAMPAIGNS
methods.equation: SWARM: k staggered launches; DISRUPT-and-sweep: Q >= Q*, then re-plan against fragments

methods.name: GRAVITY-ASSIST KINETIC
methods.equation: delta = 2 asin(1 / (1 + r_p v_inf^2 / mu)); |dv| = 2 v_inf sin(delta/2)

methods.name: SAIL-BOOSTED KINETIC
methods.equation: a = a_c (AU/r)^2 cos^2(alpha) n_hat; a_c = 2 eta P_rad / sigma

methods.name: GRAPHENE SAIL (SL4)
methods.equation: sigma 3 g/m^2, a_c 2.7 mm/s^2

methods.name: DE-STAR ORBITAL LASER ARRAY
methods.equation: F = 3e-5 P_opt, 1 to 70 GW, at range

methods.name: NUCLEAR PULSE TUG (ORION)
methods.equation: dv = N x 1e7 N s / M

methods.name: FUSION TUG
methods.equation: F = 50 kN: a year on 1e11 kg gives ~15 m/s

methods.name: ANTIMATTER STANDOFF
methods.equation: 1 g = 1.8e14 J (~43 kt); eps 0.5; no fuze limit

methods.name: LUNAR MASS-DRIVER INTERCEPTOR
methods.equation: weekly 5 t impactors at C3 up to 60

methods.name: PRE-ACCELERATED SAIL SWARM
methods.equation: 6 sail impactors at 15 km/s parked at 0.6 AU

methods.name: ASTEROID BILLIARDS
methods.equation: dv = beta 1e7 x 1e4 / M

methods.name: DISASSEMBLER SWARM
methods.equation: M(t) = M0 exp(-t / 5 yr)

methods.name: PLANETARY-SCALE CIVIL DEFENSE
methods.equation: damage x0.1 for CITY/REGIONAL

methods.name: TELEPORT
methods.equation: position += 1 AU along track
methods.forbidden: NO-CLONING THEOREM FORBIDS COPYING ITS STATE. ALSO NOBODY BUILT A RECEIVER.

methods.name: OBSERVE (QUANTUM REDIRECTION)
methods.equation: re-roll the orbit; miss with P = 1/e
methods.forbidden: WAVEFUNCTIONS OF 1E11 KG BODIES HAVE DECOHERED. WE ARE PRETENDING.

methods.name: REWIND N
methods.equation: rewind the clock n years
methods.forbidden: CLOSED TIMELIKE CURVES NOT FOUND.

methods.name: EDIT G
methods.equation: change G live
methods.forbidden: G HAS BEEN 6.674E-11 FOR 13.8 GYR.

methods.name: DELETE
methods.equation: remove the threat
methods.forbidden: MASS-ENERGY CONSERVATION VIOLATED BY 9E27 J.

methods.name: NOCLIP
methods.equation: HOME non-colliding this round
methods.forbidden: PAULI EXCLUSION STILL APPLIES TO PLANETS.

methods.name: TRACTORBEAM
methods.equation: 1e6 N at any range, no reaction mass
methods.forbidden: MOMENTUM CONSERVATION: WHO IS PUSHING BACK?

methods.name: SINGULARITY
methods.equation: t_evap = 5120 pi G^2 M^3 / (hbar c^4)
methods.forbidden: A 1E4 KG HOLE LASTS 8E-5 S AND RELEASES 9E20 J (215 MT) NEXT TO YOUR PROBE. ROUND OVER.

methods.name: WORMHOLE
methods.equation: route the threat into another branch
methods.forbidden: EXOTIC MATTER WITH NEGATIVE ENERGY DENSITY: 0 KG ON HAND.

methods.name: DIPLOMACY
methods.equation: effect 0
methods.forbidden: RESPONSE RECEIVED: 'NO.'

methods.name: DRILLCREW
methods.equation: the crew refuses
methods.forbidden: TEXAS-SIZED BODY (1.4E21 KG) NEEDS DV 6.5 M/S IN 18 D: >= 3E22 J, ABOUT 7 MILLION MEGATONS. YOU BROUGHT ONE.

methods.name: PLANETTHRUSTERS
methods.equation: move HOME by dv
methods.forbidden: 0.5 X 6E24 KG X (1 M/S)^2 = 3E24 J, ABOUT 7E8 MEGATONS.

methods.name: SHIELD
methods.equation: absorb the impact energy in a dome
methods.forbidden: 2E19 J DUMPED INTO ONE STRUCTURE. THE GRID IS A CRATER NOW.

methods.name: SHRINK
methods.forbidden: WHERE DID 99.9% OF THE MASS GO?

methods.name: SUMMONDEVS
methods.equation: opens the knobs editor
methods.forbidden: YOU ARE NOW THE SIMULATION.

methods.name: MULTIVERSE N
methods.equation: fork the round into n branches
methods.forbidden: EVERETT WOULD LIKE A WORD.

methods.name: NANOFORGE: RECONFIGURABLE-MATTER SEEDS
methods.equation: F = mdot v_e after the growth delay; the rock is its own propellant

methods.name: SELF-ASSEMBLING THRUSTER SWARM
methods.equation: F = eta_spin N F_unit, continuous from arrival

methods.name: SHEPHERD NETWORK: PARKED IMPACTOR ROCKS
methods.equation: dv = beta m_rock U / M, once per threat

methods.name: PRIMORDIAL MICRO BLACK HOLE FLY-BY
methods.equation: dv = 2 G M / (b v); 1e15 kg at 100 m, 20 km/s -> 0.067 m/s
methods.forbidden: A 1E15 KG BLACK HOLE IS 1.5E-12 M ACROSS; NONE HAS EVER BEEN FOUND.

methods.name: TIMEFOLD (RESCHEDULE THE ROCK)
methods.equation: the threat arrives n days late
methods.forbidden: NO KNOWN PHYSICS SLIDES ONE OBJECT ALONG ITS OWN WORLDLINE.

methods.name: DETOUR SIGN IN DEEP SPACE
methods.equation: the rock takes a 1.5 day detour
methods.forbidden: ROCKS FOLLOW GEODESICS, NOT SIGNAGE.

methods.name: LUNA PROTOCOL (THE MOON WAS ALWAYS A SHIP)
methods.equation: a hit this round scores as partial
methods.forbidden: THE MOON IS 7.3E22 KG OF ROCK WITH NO ENGINES.

methods.name: HOLLOW ASTEROID
methods.equation: mass / 10
methods.forbidden: RUBBLE PILES ARE UP TO HALF EMPTY SPACE, NOT NINETY PERCENT.

methods.name: A TICKET TO THE SIMULATION OPERATORS
methods.equation: one ticket per round; sometimes it is patched
methods.forbidden: THERE IS NO EVIDENCE OF OPERATORS.

methods.name: PLANET X
methods.equation: cosmetic: it is always arriving next year
methods.forbidden: INFRARED SURVEYS RULE OUT A SATURN-SIZE PLANET WITHIN ABOUT 10,000 AU.

methods.name: MANDELA AMENDMENT
methods.equation: renames the threat; sometimes it was always aimed elsewhere
methods.forbidden: MEMORY IS RECONSTRUCTIVE. ORBITS ARE NOT.
